name: Camus Holmes
source:
She is a detective girl who looks like a boy, using "boku" to call herself. In fact, Towa thinks she is a boy.

Entrust by the police, she has solved various difficult cases with her exceptional reasoning ability. Because Towa, a suspicious oriental person from a different world, was thought to be the criminal of a case, she became hostile to Towa and his friends.

She doesn't trust people basically. Therefore, she doesn’t rely on other people, preferring to act alone.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
